MR CHIRAYU A MEHTA(3256) for the Appellant(s) No. 1 MR Y J PATEL(3985) for the Defendant(s) No. 2,3 MS AMRITA AJMERA(5204) for the Defendant(s) No. 1 ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DEVAN M. DESAI  Date : 18/07/2023
ORAL ORDER

[1] The present First Appeal is filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, challenging the judgment and award dated 22.02.2012 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Aux.),
Surendranagar in M.A.C.P. No.61 of 2007.
[2] The original claimant had claimed compensation of Rs.1,50,000/- for the injuries sustained in the accident.

[3] The Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (Aux.), Surendranagar vide its order dated 22.02.2012 awarded NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/1300/2012 ORDER DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined compensation of Rs.98,800/- with interest @ 9% per annum till the date of realization.
[4] Being aggrieved and dissatisfied by the impugned judgment and award dated 22.02.2012 the present appellant i.e. Insurance Company has preferred this appeal.

sentences.text: 1 [5] This Court has heard the learned advocate for the appellant.
[6] At the outset, the learned advocate for the appellant has submitted that challenge made by the appellant in this appeal is less than Rs.1,00,000/-.

[7] Learned advocate for the appellant has fairly submitted that in view of the fact, the amount involved in the present appeal is less than Rs.1,00,000/-, this appeal may be disposed of in accordance with law.
[8] I have perused the grounds of appeal and the judgment and award dated 22.02.2012 passed by the Tribunal.

It appears that the amount involved in the NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/1300/2012 ORDER DATED:
18/07/2023 undefined present appeal is less than Rs.1,00,000/-.
In view of the small amount being involved in the present appeal, the appeal deserves to be dismissed and accordingly, it is dismissed.
The compensation awarded by the Tribunal is just and reasonable and awarded amount is less than Rs.1,00,000/-, no interference is called for.
[9] It is hereby clarified that this appeal is disposed of only on the ground of compensation awarded is less than Rs.1,00,000/-.
This Court has not expressed any opinion on merits and question of law raised in the appeal.
The question of law and the submissions on merits are kept open to be urged in appropriate appeal by the Insurance Company.
This order would not come in the way of adjudication of any other appeal pending against the same judgment and award or adjudication of any other claim petition arising out of the same accident.
Civil Application/s, if any, is pending, stands disposed of as having become infructuous.
No order as to costs.
Record and proceedings shall be returned to the concerned Tribunal forthwith.

[10] If any amount deposited in this appeal, is NEUTRAL CITATION C/FA/1300/2012 ORDER DATED: 18/07/2023 undefined ordered to be transmitted by the Registry of this Court to the concerned Tribunal forthwith along with accrued interest, if any.
The entire awarded amount be disbursed and released in favour of the claimant/s after due verification and by following due procedure by the concerned Tribunal.

(D. M. DESAI,J) MANOJ Iffco Tokio General Insurance Co. Ltd vs Bhaskarbhai Vidhyarambhai on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74748500/
